decision: RECEIPT-ONLY NEGATIVE: land no source change. The Q4 layout itself streams at the copy roof (60.1-60.2 GB/s vs 58.5 GB/s balanced copy) and is innocent; the production kernel runs at 41.0 GB/s in the in-model-style environment (69% of its own layout roof); no bit-preserving arm recovers the gap repeatably - the prefetch-depth ladder is monotonically WORSE (+9.5% us/layer at depth 2 to +24.5% at depth 8, both legs, occupancy tax), wg128 is bimodal (widedep +0.34% leg A / -4.43% leg B, fails the >=3% repeat bar), and the only faster pattern (+13%: two consecutive words per lane) changes the pinned accumulation order and is not landed. Nothing merged; wave/Q4DecodeMemoryRoof carries bench arms and this receipt only.
